description: How steep the fantasy dropoff is at each position in a given scoring format, measured from the top player to replacement level. Use this for draft-strategy questions like whether to take a running back or a wide receiver first.

scoring_format.description: Scoring format. ppr awards 1 point per reception, half_ppr 0.5, standard 0. Defaults to half_ppr, the most common league setting.

name: get_positional_scarcity

positions.description: One row per position, steepest dropoff first.

dropoff.description: Points per game lost from the top player to replacement level.

refreshed_at.description: When this dataset was last refreshed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

stats_season.description: The completed NFL season every figure in this result describes.

url.description: The draftcall.io page these figures came from. This is the citation to use.

title: Compare positional scarcity
